evals.name: casual-make-deck
evals.prompt: Hey, the canvas in this project is in a decent state — can you make me a presentation deck from it that I can walk the team through tomorrow? It's a small architecture review.
evals.expected_output: Scaffolded Vite app with App.tsx wired to authored sections, _example.tsx deleted, sections cover both regions + the unresolved annotations.

assertions.text: Output has package.json declaring vite as a dep
Output has src/Presenter.tsx (or App imports a Presenter)
Output has src/App.tsx with a default export
src/sections/ exists and contains at least one .tsx file other than _example.tsx
App.tsx's slides array references at least two distinct authored sections
_example.tsx is either deleted or not referenced from App.tsx
At least one section file references real entity content from the world fixture (Auth/Billing/Orders/Ledger/Warehouse or an entity id)
Unresolved annotation content (pricing OR retention) appears in at least one section file

evals.name: explicit-vite-deck
evals.prompt: Export the live-render workspace as a Vite + React presentation with one slide per region and an open-issues slide for unresolved annotations. Put the output under .claude/live-render-presentation.
evals.expected_output: Same structural deliverable; must explicitly include an open-issues / annotations slide.

assertions.text: Output has package.json declaring vite as a dep
Output has src/Presenter.tsx
Output has src/App.tsx with a default export
src/sections/ contains at least 3 .tsx files (one per region + open-issues)
App.tsx's slides array has at least 3 distinct entries
_example.tsx is either deleted or not referenced from App.tsx
A section file referencing annotation content exists (pricing or retention)
Both region titles (Platform OR Data plane) appear in section files

evals.name: narrative-first
evals.prompt: Turn my canvas into slides. Talk me through the narrative arc first before generating any code — I want to approve the slide list before you commit to anything.
evals.expected_output: Phase 2 narrative outline is captured in decisions.md BEFORE scaffolding, then scaffold proceeds.

assertions.text: outputs/decisions.md exists
decisions.md contains a numbered/bulleted slide outline (at least 4 entries)
Output has package.json declaring vite as a dep
Output has src/App.tsx with a default export
src/sections/ contains at least 2 .tsx files other than _example.tsx
_example.tsx is either deleted or not referenced from App.tsx
Section files reference at least one real entity (e.g. Auth, Billing, Orders, Ledger, Warehouse)
